[[File:Iego_system.jpg|thumb|right|300px|The moons of Iego]]
'''Moons of Iego''' was the common name given to the forty-two [[Moon/Legends|moons]] that [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Iego/Legends|Iego]]. The moons were referred to as a single group due to the belief that beautiful [[Diathim/Legends|angels]] inhabited the moons.
